blocks.heading: The pack is a book
blocks.body:
Send the **map** plus the **pages** it points at. Say what to comment on. Say do not rename files. A renamed file is a broken pointer.

Do not send `out/` publish folders. Do not send your whole `oxygen-bootcamp-work/` tree. Git can wait until the reviewer has a repo.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Reviewer folder plus cover note.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You send the whole oxygen-bootcamp-work tree, or you omit the map, or you include a publish out/ folder.

Expected: A small pack with the map, the pages, and a cover note a non-writer can follow.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Reviewer folder plus cover note.
blocks.intro: How to Reviewer folder plus cover note. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Reviewer folder plus cover note
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Copy kitepump.ditamap and its topics into oxygen-bootcamp-work/week7/reviewer-pack/.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Add README-reviewer.txt: open the map in Maps Manager; comment only on prime-the-pump.dita; do not rename files.

image.alt: New Project dialog in Oxygen XML Editor
image.caption: File > New Project. This dialog is how a blank project gets a name and a folder.
image.credit: Oxygen XML Editor User Guide, Syncro Soft

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: List every file in the pack in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week7/reviewer-list.txt. Do not include out/ publish folders.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: If you use Git at work, write one line: this week the pack is a folder (or a zip) because the reviewer has no repo.

blocks.summary: A small pack with the map, the pages, and a cover note a non-writer can follow.

blocks.body: The lab is done. Prove it with the check. Use words from today only.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: A reviewer without Oxygen should receive only the one topic file. True or not?
options: Not true :  keys and sibling pages break without the map. Send the tiny book, or use a browser review tool
True if the file name is FINAL
blocks.why: The booklet holds the pointers. One loose page loses its neighbors and its product name key.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: What stays out of a reviewer pack?
options: Publish output folders (out/) and the rest of your disk
blocks.why: Send the book. Do not send last week’s HTML, and do not send every file you have ever saved.
